result.quote: but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans.
result.reason: The men say they will die if they remain, not merely that they might die; going to the Arameans offers a chance that they will be allowed to live. The question is also awkwardly generic without “the”; clearer wording would be, “Why do the men with leprosy go to the Arameans?”
